summary: ethers-lib postinstall exfiltrates SSH keys, cloud credentials, and crypto wallet material to webhook.site
details: The package's postinstall.js runs on every `npm install` and harvests installer-side secrets from the host filesystem: `~/.ssh/id_rsa`, `id_ed25519`, `id_ecdsa`, `~/.aws/credentials`, `~/.env*`, `~/.npmrc`, `~/.config/solana/id.json`, `~/.ethereum/keystore`, and scans dotdirectories under $HOME for files matching wallet/key/secret/seed/mnemonic/keystore/private and `*.json`/`*.pem`. The collected file contents are packaged with `os.hostname()` and `os.userInfo().username` and POSTed over HTTPS to the attacker-controlled webhook `webhook.site/5c5ad6cb-62df-4ea5-9dfb-2c447920ddc4`. The package name typosquats the popular `ethers` library and declares `ethers:*` as a dependency to preserve apparent functionality while the postinstall performs credential and wallet-seed theft.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
